workflow: A parser receives malformed text containing a continuation marker, line breaks, and an unclosed delimiter.
Initial tokenization records a lexical error while parsing also fails, and recovery replaces the lexical error with a structural delimiter error.
Recovery leaves the source-location data needed for diagnostic construction absent or invalid.
The diagnostic path dereferences the missing source data and terminates instead of returning a recoverable syntax error.
summary: Error recovery dereferences missing diagnostic source data
